verdict.rationale: Bland ships an MCP *server* so coding agents can control the Bland account (docs-11/20/27, probe-3/probe-rt-2), which is the opposite role from what the story asks — the voice agent itself acting as an MCP *client* that plugs in external MCP servers as tool sources mid-call. Tool/function calling is documented only via custom HTTP API integrations (bland-docs-4, bland-docs-25), with no mention of the agent consuming MCP servers as a toolset source during calls.
